The '''Braccio system''' was a [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The system shared its name with the [[Braccio campaign]], a conflict that occurred<ref name="CrisisOfFaith">{{StoryCite|story=Crisis of Faith|book=Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition}}</ref> around [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].<ref name="Date">{{StoryCite|story=Crisis of Faith|book=Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition}} establishes that the [[Braccio campaign]] took place shortly after [[Nuso Esva]]'s [[Battle of the Poln system|incursion]] into the [[Candoras sector/Legends|Candoras sector]], which is depicted in ''[[Choices of One]]'' and dated by ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Braccio system was first mentioned in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed it within grid square I-5.<ref name="EAOC" />
